hooks.name: Scan the hackathon submission on save
hooks.description: Kiro IDE 1.0 v1 hook (trigger, matcher, action, timeout, enabled). Fires when a pattern module, anything under hackathon/, docs/article/article.md or the root README.md is saved, whether Kiro reports the path relative, with a ./ prefix or absolute under the strands-robots-deepracer workspace. Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/hooks/

action.prompt: A submission file changed. From the repo root run `.venv/bin/python hackathon/scan_submission.py --repo . --article docs/article/article.md` and summarise the output: list every FAIL row first (file, rule, what is missing), then every WARN row, each with the one-line fix. If the scanner reports zero FAIL and zero WARN, say so in one line. Do not edit any file; report only. Remember the house line: physics stops the car; the decider explains.
